description: Google is rebranding NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook, the company announced on Thursday. The AI-powered research and note-taking assistant, which was originally announced as Project Tailwind at Google I/O 2023, has evolved into a standalone research platform in recent years. Google claims it is now used by more than 30 million people and over 600,000 organisations worldwide. Alongside the rebranding, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced several other upgrades.
title: Google Rebrands NotebookLM as Gemini Notebook; Brings Cloud Computing and Search Integration

description: Samsung launched the Music Studio 5 (LS50H) and Music Studio 7 (LS70H) in India. The new speakers are compatible with Samsung TVs and soundbars. They feature dot design and offer AI Dynamic Bass Control. The new range has a starting price tag of Rs. 27,900 in India. The latest Wi-Fi speakers designed by Erwan Bouroullec.
title: Samsung Music Studio 5, Music Studio 7 Wi-Fi Speakers Launched in India

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out a shortcut that lets iPhone users access Apple's microphone modes directly during calls. According to WABetaInfo, the feature is available with WhatsApp for iOS version 26.27.74 and is expected to expand to more users over time. The shortcut reportedly opens Apple's built-in microphone menu, allowing users to switch between Standard, Voice Isolation, Wide Spectrum and Automatic modes. Unlike Android, WhatsApp is said to rely on Apple's existing audio processing instead of its own system.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Rolls Out Mic Mode Controls for iPhone Calls

description: Oppo and OnePlus are working on two new smartphones that will be equipped with 10,000mAh or larger capacity batteries, a tipster claims in a post on Weibo. Oppo is tipped to first launch an unspecified Oppo A series handset equipped with a 10,000mAh single-cell battery. On the other hand, OnePlus is reportedly planning to launch a mid-range phone with Pro branding and model number SM8845 next year, which might arrive with a battery larger than 10,000mAh. However, the OnePlus handset is said to be in the “pre-research” (translated from Chinese) phase.
title: Oppo’s New A Series, Upcoming OnePlus Mid-Range Smartphones Tipped to Launch With 10,000mAh Batteries

description: Decentralised trading protocol Ostium has suspended trading after blockchain security firms Blockaid and CertiK reported a suspected exploit involving its liquidity vault. While estimated losses range between $18 million and $22 million, Ostium said it is still investigating the incident and has not confirmed the cause or financial impact. The suspected oracle-related breach adds to a growing number of DeFi security incidents recorded during the second quarter of 2026.
title: Ostium Suspends Trading Following Oracle Security Incident Drains Millions
AI for Everyone: Whether You Are an AI Expert or Just Getting Started, MSI Has a Laptop for You

description: Realme India has reportedly confirmed that future smartphones in the country will ship with ColorOS 17 instead of Realme UI. According to a recent report, eligible existing devices will also receive the new software through future operating system updates. The reported transition is intended to simplify software development and software updates. The Realme GT 8 Pro is expected to move to ColorOS 17 as part of its promised Android upgrade cycle, while the reported change currently applies only to India.
title: Realme Could Replace Realme UI With ColorOS 17 in India: Report

description: Apple Back to School sale is now live in India, offering discounts on MacBook models and iPad models, along with the opportunity for students, their parents, and teachers to get their hands on various accessories, like the AirPods 4, Apple Pencil, and AirTags for free. The MacBook Air (2026) with the M5 processor can be purchased at a starting price of Rs. 1,37,900, including the Students Savings discount. Additionally, customers can choose to get the base AirPods 4 or the pack of four AirTags bundle for free. Alternatively, they can choose to get AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) at Rs. 5,000 or the AirPods Pro 3 at Rs. 13,000.
title: Apple Back to School Sale Now Live in India, Bringing Offers on MacBook Air, iPad Pro and More

description: The Zenbook A14 features a sleek, premium design language. The laptop packs a 14-inch Full HD+ OLED display that delivers decent colour accuracy. It also features a powerful Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite processor that delivers decent performance and long-lasting battery life. The device also features an ErgoSense keyboard with decent key travel and a large touchpad for a smooth typing and scrolling experience.
title: Asus Zenbook A14 (2026) Review: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Performance Twist We Didn't Expect

description: Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy S12 Ultra later this year. While we haven't received any official word about the launch of the Android tablets yet, a new leak reveals the design and a few specifications of the  Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra. It is said to come with a 14.6-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display. It could feature a dual rear camera unit and reportedly measure 326.34 x 208.46 x 5.12mm.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra CAD Renders Leaked Online; Reveals Familiar Look

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is coming out on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X on November 19, 2026, and is expected to launch on PC sometime later. Rockstar has not yet confirmed a PC port of the game. A former Rockstar producer has now explained why the studio launches its games on consoles first.
title: Former Rockstar Games Developer Explains Why GTA 6 Maker Launches Games on PC After Consoles

description: OnePlus on Thursday announced a significant shift in its software strategy. As part of the changes, eligible smartphones will be transitioned from OxygenOS to Oppo's ColorOS following the release of Android 17 later this year. Users with supported devices will be able to voluntarily upgrade to the new software. OnePlus claims this move is aimed at unifying software development with parent company Oppo. Separately, the company also announced the winding down of operations in select global markets.
title: OnePlus Announces Transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS With Android 17; to Cease Europe, US Operations

description: Samsung's first wide-folding Galaxy Z Fold model made an unexpected appearance in a new Spider-Man: Brand New Day collaboration video, titled “A brand new shape for a Brand New Day”. A new microsite for Samsung’s new Spider-Man: Brand New Day collaboration is now live in the US. The microsite lets users pre-order the new Galaxy devices, which will be launched during the upcoming Galaxy Unpacked event next week. The Marvel superhero can be seen with a Samsung foldable, sporting the “new shape”. Only a glimpse of the handset appears, suggesting that it could be the rumoured wide-folding Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8.
title: Samsung and Spider-Man Come Together to Tease the ‘New Shape’ of the Next Galaxy Z Fold

description: Bitcoin traded above $64,500 on Thursday as improving macroeconomic conditions supported crypto markets. Analysts said selective buying, uneven ETF demand and geopolitical risks will determine whether the recovery can extend beyond current resistance levels.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $64,500 as Institutional Demand Remains Mixed

description: Lenovo Legion Y700 Infinite will launch in August in China. Latest teasers shared by Lenovo confirm the chipset details of the upcoming tablet. It is set to offer LPDDR5T RAM and UFS 4.1 Pro storage. It will include a 15,000 sq mm vapour chamber for thermal management. It will offer 5G connectivity.  Lenovo Legion Y700 Infinite is tipped to feature an 8-inch OLED display.
title: Lenovo Legion Y700 Infinite Chipset Details Teased Officially; Key Specifications Tipped Online

description: Nubia has revealed the name, design and colour options of its upcoming AI-powered smartphone ahead of its debut at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026. Called the Nubia NaviX Ultra, the handset will be available in Black, Pink, Purple and White. Official teasers also confirm the presence of the Doubao AI assistant and show an orange side button alongside a redesigned rear camera layout. The company is expected to announce the smartphone's specifications, pricing and availability during the event.
title: Nubia NaviX Ultra Design, Colour Options Unveiled Ahead of July 17 Launch

description: Codex Micro has been launched in global markets. Developed through a collaboration between OpenAI and keyboard maker Work Louder, the Codex Micro has native Codex integration. It has Bluetooth and USB Type-C connectivity and is compatible with Mac and Windows systems. It has RGB lighting, and each Agent Key lights up with a live RGB status from Codex.
title: Codex Micro Launched as a Dedicated Controller for OpenAI Codex Power Users: Price, Features

description: Following the launch of the Redmi 17C 4G in China earlier this year, the company appears to be gearing up to expand its Redmi number series. According to a report, the Redmi 17 4G is in the works as the successor to the Redmi 15. Ahead of its anticipated debut, alleged renders of the purported handset have surfaced online, which reveal its design and colour options. The leak also sheds light on the handset's expected specifications.
title: Redmi 17 4G Price, Specifications and Renders Reportedly Surface Ahead of Launch

description: A new CMF audio device called the CMF Clip Pro has been listed on Singapore's IMDA certification platform. The database identifies it as wireless Bluetooth earphones and reveals the product name, but does not disclose any specifications or launch details. The branding has fuelled speculation that the earbuds could adopt a clip-style design, although this remains unconfirmed. The listing follows earlier certification sightings of the CMF Buds Neo and Nothing Ear 3a, pointing to additional audio launches from the company.
title: CMF Clip Pro Reportedly Spotted on IMDA, Could Debut as Clip-Style Earbuds

description: Sony has revealed the slate of games coming to PS Plus Game Catalogue in July. The game subscription service will add Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, Rise of the Ronin, Dying Light, Citizen Sleeper 2, among other games this month. All titles will be playable starting July 21.
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Titles for July Announced: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora, Rise of the Ronin and More

description: Vivo T5 Lite 5G has been launched in India. The new Vivo T series smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in the country on July 22 via Flipkart and the Vivo India online store. The handset is offered in two colour options, namely Twilight Shadow and Wave Blue, and three RAM and storage configurations. It is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 6300, which is built on a 6nm process. The Vivo T5 Lite 5G is equipped with a 6,500mAh battery with support for 44W wired fast charging. It carries a 50-megapixel camera on the back.
title: Vivo T5 Lite 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Realme C100x was launched in India in two colour options. It has a 6.8-inch HD+ (720×1,570 pixels) LCD panel with a 120Hz refresh rate. It runs on a Unisoc T7250 chipset paired with an Arm Mali-G57 GPU, 6GB LPDDR4X RAM and up to 256GB eMMC5.1 storage. It features an 8,000mAh battery that supports 45W fast charging and a 50-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Realme C100x Launched in India With 8,000mAh Battery, 6.8-Inch Display: Price, Specifications

description: Google has officially previewed the Pixel 11 series through a new video on the Google Store homepage. The teaser introduces Pixel Glow, a new rear lighting element capable of displaying multiple colours, and confirms that pre-orders will begin on August 12. Google is also offering eligible US customers a promotional code for Pixel 11 purchases through a limited-time email sign-up programme. The company is expected to unveil four Pixel 11 models and the Pixel Watch 5 during its Made by Google event.
title: Google Pixel 11 Teased Ahead of August 12 Launch, Pixel Glow Feature Confirmed

description: The Redmi Note 17 series was recently launched in China, comprising two models — Redmi Note 17 and Note 17 Pro. While the Xiaomi sub-brand has remained tight-lipped on its global availability, the rumour mill now suggests that the India launch of the Redmi Note 17 could be on the horizon. According to a tipster, the smartphone could be introduced in the country next month. However, it remains unknown if the Note 17 Pro will make its way to the Indian market, too.
title: Redmi Note 17 India Launch Tipped for August; Specifications to Differ From China Variant

description: The UK government's Department for Science, Innovation and Technology has announced that it plans to impose a nighttime social media curfew for 16 and 17-year-olds, which will be turned on by default. The curfew will begin at midnight and last till 6 am local time. The government also plans to switch off features on social media apps that can “keep users scrolling for longer”, including videos that can automatically play one after another, along with personalised feeds that curate content for older teenagers. Similar to the nighttime social media curfew, these features will also be turned off by default.
title: UK Government Plans Social Media Curfews for Teenagers Under New Online Safety Rules

description: ViewSonic ViewBoard IN04V-N Series was launched in India on Thursday as the company's latest premium interactive display lineup for classrooms, boardrooms, and collaborative workspaces. The company claims it is the first offering in its lineup to feature an integrated 48-megapixel AI camera. It is also equipped with an eight-microphone array, AI-powered collaboration tools, and a 4K Ultra HD touchscreen display. The interactive display runs on Android 16 EDLA and supports hybrid meetings, training sessions, and interactive learning environments.
title: ViewSonic ViewBoard IN04V-N Series Launched in India With AI Camera, 4K Interactive Display: Price, Specifications

description: Google has updated Gmail's Gemini-powered Help Me Write feature with custom refinement capabilities that let users edit AI-generated email drafts using their own instructions. The update removes the need to rely only on preset editing options and also introduces undo and redo controls for AI edits. It is enabled by default for eligible users and is rolling out across Rapid Release and Scheduled Release domains until July 20. The feature is available across supported Google AI and Workspace plans.
title: Google Upgrades Gmail Help Me Write With Custom AI Email Edits

description: Apple is reportedly in talks with semiconductor startups for potential acquisitions.  The company is said to have had words with bankers about possible deals. The interest in chip acquisitions comes as the company face challenges with its internal AI servers, which currently run on internally designed M2 Ultra chips.
title: Apple Approaches Chip Startups for Potential Acquisitions as It Looks to Strengthen AI Efforts: Report

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 will be equipped with a 7.6-inch foldable Dynamic AMOLED 2X display on the inside, according to a report. The display is said to refresh at up to 120Hz and offer a 16:9 aspect ratio. On the outside, the handset could sport a 5.5-inch cover display with up to 120Hz. The smartphone might also carry a dual rear camera unit, featuring two 50-megapixel shooters. For selfies and videos, it might sport a 10-megapixel camera on the cover display and another on the inside. The smartphone is expected to launch along with the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra during the Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Key Specifications Surface Online Before Anticipated Launch

description: OnePlus’ future has been one of uncertainty for some time now. While previous rumours suggested the company could be winding up operations, it eventually merged with Realme under Oppo's umbrella. However, a new report suggests that the company could cease operations in the US and Europe as early as this week, with India said to follow at a later stage in 2027.
title: OnePlus Could Exit India by 2027 as Part of Oppo’s Global Restructuring Plans: Report

description: The Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition appears to build upon the regular model by giving it an identity that feels different. Instead of relying on the branding alone, it also implements special packaging, materials, styling, and software, which all work together. Purely from a design perspective, this is among the more thoughtfully executed special editions we have recently seen in the mid-range segment.
title: Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition First Impressions
